plan.currentContract: Feel Bridge 1 with optional state/edit hooks; immutable builds, sandbox, hash verification and workspace/2.
plan.whyExistingIsInsufficient: restoreState means restart and one project-wide schema cannot preserve legacy A alongside expanded B.
plan.design: Versioned optional applyState hook for in-place full configuration sync; editable declarations carry apply and group. Per-build config/ranges optional, old project schema fallback. A remains byte-identical; B owns live validation/physics/audio/render updates.
plan.migration: No key migration; v04 reads old workspace/2 and keeps old node schema/hash; old runtimes unchanged. New B added explicitly through a catalog build selector for saved workspaces.
plan.compatibility: Keep old v2/v3 runtime files and hashes, prototypes and legacy JSON unchanged; versioned v04 source used only by Studio entry and B.
plan.promotionRisk: Staging trial only; author decides whether to keep or expand.
